name: New Zealand
oneLineFragment: Aoraki Southern Alps glacial valleys and braided river gravel.
narrativeStory:
Milky glacial runoff pouring down the Hooker Valley towards Tasman Lake. The Southern Alps form an insurmountable backbone against the Tasman Sea, catching colossal precipitation that forms permanent ice shelves.

Alpine kea parrots call across the scree basins, while the morning light casts long sharp shadows across the braided riverbeds.
subtitle: Aoraki / Mount Cook National Park • Southern Alps
introLines: Tussock slopes shivering in fierce alpine wind.
Braided glacier rivers flowing to grey moraine lakes.
Eight frames documenting the Southern Alps glacier terminus.
